chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I heard Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام say: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to perform ghusl with a sa', and when one of his wives was with him, he would perform ghusl with a sa' and a mudd.

key_terms.بِصَاعٍ: with a sa', a known measure of volume used for water
key_terms.مُدٍّ: a mudd, a smaller unit of measure added to the sa'

ai.seo_question: How much water is sufficient for ghusl according to the hadith of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the amount of water the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used for ghusl, indicating moderation in ritual purification. It also notes that when one of his wives was with him, the amount used was a sa' and a mudd, which is relevant to jurisprudential discussions on the sufficient quantity of water for ghusl.
